stock.description: King's Flair International (Holdings) Limited operates as an investment holding firm, primarily engaged in the global supply of kitchenware and household items across the United States, Europe, Asia, Canada, and other international markets. Its diverse product portfolio includes bakeware, drinkware, various tools, gadgets, and food preparation accessories. The company also handles the retail, wholesale, distribution, and trading of these kitchen products, in addition to dealing in raw materials like plastic and silicone. Established in 1984, the company is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
